x-scripts-legend.dev: Daily development — Next, Express, FastAPI on the host (hot reload).
x-scripts-legend.dev:full: dev:infra:up then dev (DB in Docker, apps on host).
x-scripts-legend.local: Full stack on your machine — Docker Swarm, HTTP, infra/swarm/stack.local.yml. Needs root .env. Use local:up to build images and deploy.
x-scripts-legend.production: Azure-style deploy — infra/swarm/stack.yml (HTTPS). production:deploy loads root .env then docker stack deploy (see docs/deployment-azure.md).
x-scripts-legend.local:down / production:down: Both run docker stack rm finnplay (same stack name for local or production manifest).

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:python" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:full: npm run dev:infra:up && npm run dev
scripts.dev:migrate-database: cd server && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.local:up: npm run local:build && npm run local:deploy
